subject: document() not creating '@import' entry in NAMESPACE

messages.author: 92a46c9449c605e2
messages.subject: document() not creating '@import' entry in NAMESPACE
parts:
Hi,

I believe I'm encountering something weird with devtools::document().  Can anyone help me determine whether or not this is user error on my part?

I've listed several packages in the "Imports:" line of my DESCRIPTION file.  I was expecting an "import()" entry in NAMESPACE as a result of running devtools::document().  No such entry was created.

After installing ... functions in my package fail unless they use 'require' before calling functions from the imported packages.  I want to avoid this for two reasons: 1) to avoid the notification messaging that occurs when those dependencies are loaded, and 2) CRAN's "Writing R Extensions" guide says require should be avoided and only used exceptionally.

Any ideas?

Thanks
